items.title: Indie Games Fund in Africa: Meet the selected studios
items.content: Google Play selects 10 African indie studios for the 2026 Indie Games Fund, awarding $1M and mentorship to scale local talent globally.
items.contentSnippet: Google Play selects 10 African indie studios for the 2026 Indie Games Fund, awarding $1M and mentorship to scale local talent globally.

name: Nicola Julius
title: Head of Ecosystem and Core Partnerships EMEA

summaries.zh: 谷歌Play为非洲10家独立游戏工作室遴选入围2026年独立游戏基金，提供100万美元奖金及导师指导，旨在全球推广本土人才。
summaries.en: Google Play has selected 10 African indie game studios for the 2026 Indie Games Fund. The initiative awards $1 million and mentorship to help scale local talent globally. The chosen studios will receive support to develop and distribute their games internationally. This program aims to foster growth in the African gaming industry by providing resources and global exposure. The fund highlights Google Play's commitment to empowering emerging developers on the continent.
